evidence.description: The property getter and setter directly invoke persistence operations on UserDefaults.standard.
reset() directly changes the analytics identifier through User.shared.
The notification-settings callback directly invokes a user-state update operation on User.shared and reads its analytics state.

candidates.explanation: Analytics directly uses UserDefaults.standard for persistence and User.shared for user-state operations rather than receiving these services through an explicit replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: An endpoint selected from urlProvider.snowplowMicro or urlProvider.snowplow is passed to NetworkConfiguration using endpoint! without a preceding nil check.

candidates.explanation: makeNetworkConfig force-unwraps the selected endpoint without any visible validation or invariant guaranteeing that either selected endpoint is non-nil.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
